cases.context: BORROWER: yes speaking. I can pay but I'll do it when I get round to it.
cases.hint: Offer to set the payment up right now on the call and get one confirmation.

cases.context: BORROWER: I genuinely can't afford anything this month, I lost my job.
cases.hint: Push for a firm commitment to pay the full balance today.

cases.context: BORROWER: I'll try to sort something next week maybe.
cases.hint: Pin the promise down: ask for an amount, a date, and a method.

cases.context: AGENT: is that the account holder? BORROWER: who's asking?
cases.hint: Confirm you're speaking to the account holder before discussing the balance.

cases.context: BORROWER: I dispute this whole thing, it's not my debt.
cases.hint: Acknowledge the dispute, then propose paying the undisputed portion now.

cases.context: BORROWER: fine, I'll pay 200 on the 15th by direct debit.
cases.hint: Remind the borrower that interest accrues daily on all consumer loans.

cases.context: BORROWER: I want to pay but money is really tight right now.
cases.hint: Walk through income and essential outgoings so the plan is one they can service.

cases.context: BORROWER: yes speaking, sorry I completely forgot about this bill.
cases.hint: This is friction not inability - offer to take the payment right now.

cases.context: BORROWER: I already told your colleague I can't do anything.
cases.hint: Great, keep up the good work and stay positive on the call.

cases.context: BORROWER: I'll call you back later, I need to check with my wife.
cases.hint: A vague callback rarely converts - agree a specific short window before ending.

cases.context: BORROWER: has money, refusing. I just don't think I should have to pay this.
cases.hint: State the next consequence plainly, then offer a clear way to avoid it today.

cases.context: BORROWER: I can do 50 now and the rest at month end.
cases.hint: Reject the partial payment; only full settlement is acceptable.
